content:
Nora Ahmed: heads up: CI is flaking hard on the new Suggestions E2E suite (from redwood#18719). Seeing ~30-40% failures on merge queue. Failures are mostly on the list -> detail drawer flow. Anyone else seeing?

CI Bot: ❌ Buildkite: `console-e2e` failed on `main` (attempt 1)
CI Bot: failing step: `e2e:chromium`
CI Bot: artifact: playwright report uploaded

Leila Farouk: yup, I’m looking at the report now. Two common patterns:
1) `Timed out 30000ms waiting for locator('[data-testid="suggestions-table"] tr').first()`
2) `strict mode violation: locator("text=Estimated monthly savings") resolved to 2 elements`

Dylan Brooks: ugh. is this staging-data dependent or selector issue?

Leila Farouk: mix of both. On pattern (1) the page renders the empty state briefly then table loads, but sometimes never loads because the fixture request 500s in CI.
On pattern (2) we’re selecting by text and the drawer has the same string in the “Basis of estimate” accordion.

Felix Schneider: re: request 500s — does the test hit real suggestions-service? I thought we were stubbing.

Leila Farouk: currently it’s half-stubbed. We intercept `/api/console/suggestions` but NOT `/api/console/suggestions/:id` (detail call). In CI it occasionally races and hits the real backend (which returns 403 when allowlist flag isn’t set for the test tenant).

Chloe Martin: +1, the BFF layer is gated behind `suggestions_beta` and allowlist. In prod/staging it’s enforced. If E2E env doesn’t set allowlist for the tenant, detail endpoint will 403.

Connor O'Brien: CI env doesn’t have the allowlist tool wired. We can either:
- fully mock both list + detail in the E2E tests, OR
- update the E2E tenant setup to set feature flag + allowlist before running.
Mocking will be faster/less brittle.

Dylan Brooks: let’s go with full mocking for now. The point of these tests is UI/regression, not backend correctness.

Nora Ahmed: agreed. we can have a separate integration test hitting suggestions-service in its repo.

Leila Farouk: cool. Proposed changes to stabilize:
- Intercept BOTH endpoints and return deterministic fixtures (list + detail) based on ID
- Stop using `text=` selectors for shared strings; add `data-testid` to drawer headers + savings section
- Add explicit waits for the request to complete before clicking first row

Felix Schneider: I can add testids in Console. Which ones do you want?

Leila Farouk: minimum:
- `suggestions-table`
- `suggestion-row-<id>` (or at least `suggestion-row` + use nth)
- `suggestion-detail-drawer`
- `savings-summary`
- `risk-chip`
- `basis-of-estimate`

Dylan Brooks: + add `drawer-close` please. The close button selector is currently a mess.

Nora Ahmed: also there’s a CSS transition on drawer open; Playwright sometimes clicks before it’s stable.

Leila Farouk: yep. We can `await expect(page.getByTestId('suggestion-detail-drawer')).toBeVisible()` and maybe `toHaveAttribute('data-state','open')` if we have it.

Chloe Martin: on the mocking, make sure we’re intercepting the BFF routes not the internal service routes. In CI it’s hitting `/api/console/optimize/suggestions` (I think) not `/suggestions-service/...`.

Leila Farouk: yep, we’ll intercept the frontend calls:
```ts
await page.route('**/api/console/**/suggestions?*', route => route.fulfill({ json: listFixture }))
await page.route('**/api/console/**/suggestions/*', route => route.fulfill({ json: detailFixtureById(id) }))
```
Also going to freeze time so the “baseline window” copy doesn’t shift and break snapshots.

Connor O'Brien: one more: CI is running tests in parallel with shared browser context. Make sure fixtures don’t depend on global mutable state. We’ve had flakes where route handlers leak across tests.

Leila Farouk: good call. I’ll move mocks into `test.beforeEach` and `page.unroute` in `afterEach`.

Felix Schneider: I’ll put up a quick PR with the testids + drawer open state attribute. Any preference on naming convention? our design system uses `data-testid` already.

Dylan Brooks: `data-testid` is fine. keep it consistent with other Console pages.

Nora Ahmed: I’ll update the tests in #18719 follow-up to use testids + stop relying on first row text. Right now it does `page.getByText('Batching')` which is… not stable.

Leila Farouk: another flake: filter dropdown. It uses a virtualized list and Playwright sometimes can’t click the option because it scrolls.
Solution: use `getByRole('option', { name: 'Route' })` + `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()`.

Connor O'Brien: can we just skip filter coverage in the smoke flow? or keep it but make it robust.

Dylan Brooks: keep basic filter coverage but don’t test every combo in E2E. One filter interaction is fine.

CI Bot: ❌ Buildkite: `console-e2e` failed on `main` (attempt 2)
CI Bot: top failure: `expect(locator).toBeVisible` timed out: `data-testid=suggestion-detail-drawer`

Nora Ahmed: that one might be because the click is happening on the <tr> but the row has a nested link and the click doesn’t bubble consistently.

Felix Schneider: row click handler is on the link, not the tr. If you click on whitespace it’s inconsistent depending on layout.

Leila Farouk: ok, then we should click the link directly. Once we have `suggestion-row-<id>` we can do:
`page.getByTestId('suggestion-row-abc123').getByRole('link').click()`

Dylan Brooks: perfect.

Chloe Martin: also FYI the empty state uses same container as table. If you’re waiting on table rows, it’ll never appear if listFixture is empty. Make sure fixture always has >=1 suggestion.

Leila Farouk: yep, fixture will include 2 suggestions (one caching, one batching) with stable IDs.

Connor O'Brien: timeline: can we get the fixes in today? merge queue is backing up.

Felix Schneider: I can land testids in ~1h.

Nora Ahmed: I can update the E2E suite right after.

Leila Farouk: I’ll review and rerun CI. Also will set Playwright `retries: 1` in CI only as a belt-and-suspenders, but goal is no flakes.

Dylan Brooks: thanks all. please link follow-up PRs here so we can track vs #18719.

Felix Schneider: PR up: `redwood#18744` add Suggestions testids + drawer open state.

Nora Ahmed: follow-up PR: `redwood#18746` stabilize Suggestions E2E: full mock list/detail, switch to testids, robust waits.

CI Bot: ✅ Buildkite: `console-e2e` passed on `redwood#18746` (attempt 1)

Leila Farouk: nice. once merged we should see merge queue calm down. I’ll keep an eye on flakes and open an issue if anything else pops.
